The [nested checked-record archive](../evidence/nested-checked-record-wit-20261016/index.json)
adds the acyclic `Packet`, `Holder` and `Choice` forms. The nested `Packet` is a
WIT record whose `Fin 10` digit and checked `Nat` word use canonical
little-endian `list<u32>` limbs. Installed components check direct and repeated
inputs, arrays, lists, options, products, both `Except` branches,
`Holder.packet`, and the active `Choice` packet field. Constructor-free results
return arrays and options containing `Packet` records without proof fields or
input-constructor metadata.

All four ordinary/reviewed and full/result-only selections reproduce complete
component archives from two author roots. After author removal, the public C
caller is compiled once, its source is removed, and the executable runs before
and after installation relocation, for two executions per selection. The
compiler-free runs use Wasmtime 42.0.1 and wasm-tools 1.245.1 on Linux
x64/glibc 2.36. Invalid nested fields preserve the complete Component Model
value tree and output sentinel, and a later valid call succeeds. The component
requires its packaged native Lean host; it is not a standalone WASI command.
Generic, recursive or inherited checked records, other index kinds, open
dependent or zero-payload records, callbacks and owned positions remain
separate work.
